question: 各地区订单状态分布情况
gold_sql: select r.region_name, o.status, count(distinct o.order_id) from orders o left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id left join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id group by 1,2
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, o.status, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name, o.status
ORDER BY r.region_name, o.status
